# telnyx_ai_test_metric (Data Source)

A metric of the AI test framework, which grades test conversations of the agents it applies to.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Read-Only

- `add_to_new_agents` (Boolean) Whether the metric is attached to newly created test agents by default.
- `agent` (Number)
- `agent_names` (List of String)
- `agents` (List of Number) Test agent IDs the metric is attached to.
- `alert_filters` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `alert_type` (String)
- `audio_enabled` (Boolean)
- `configuration` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `description` (String)
- `display_order` (Number)
- `enum_values` (List of String) Allowed values for qualitative enum metrics.
- `eval_type` (String) What the metric scores: numeric, continuous_qualitative, or binary_workflow_adherence.
- `evaluation_trigger` (String)
- `evaluation_trigger_custom_code` (String)
- `evaluation_trigger_prompt` (String)
- `ewma_alpha` (Number) Smoothing factor for the alert trend.
- `function_name` (String) Built-in evaluation function used by custom_code metrics.
- `kb_file_ids` (List of Number)
- `knowledge_base_files` (List of String)
- `metric_cost` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `observability_enabled` (Boolean)
- `overall_score` (Number)
- `priority_assignment_prompt` (String)
- `project` (Number)
- `prompt` (String) Judge prompt used by llm_judge metrics.
- `sample_rate` (Number)
- `sampling_enabled` (Boolean)
- `significant_change_alert_direction` (String)
- `significant_change_alert_status` (String)
- `simulation_enabled` (Boolean)
- `slug` (String) Stable identifier of a built-in metric.
- `std_multiplier` (Number) Standard-deviation multiplier for significant-change alerts.
- `total_score` (Number)
- `trigger_type` (String)
- `type` (String) How the metric is evaluated: custom_code or llm_judge.
- `user_defined` (Boolean)
- `uses_llm_judge` (Boolean)
- `window_size` (Number) Sliding window size the alert status is computed over.
